description: This file defines types, functions, and logic for managing and reporting the status of skills within the OpenClaw project, including resolving skill configurations, selecting installation options, and building skill status reports.

classes.name: SkillStatusConfigCheck
classes.description: Type alias for requirement configuration checks.

classes.name: SkillInstallOption
classes.description: Type representing an installation option for a skill.

classes.name: SkillStatusEntry
classes.description: Type representing the status information of a skill.

classes.name: SkillStatusReport
classes.description: Type representing a report of skills' statuses within a workspace.

methods.name: resolveSkillKey
methods.description: Resolves the unique key for a skill entry.

methods.name: selectPreferredInstallSpec
methods.description: Selects the preferred installation specification based on preferences and availability.

methods.name: normalizeInstallOptions
methods.description: Normalizes and filters install options for a skill based on platform and preferences.

methods.name: buildSkillStatus
methods.description: Builds the status object for a given skill entry.

methods.name: buildWorkspaceSkillStatus
methods.description: Generates a report of all skills' statuses in a workspace.
